Steal the small treasure of the greedy goblins of the {wiki:Edron Goblin Cave}, west of the city. Cross the cave from the Edron castle sewer, go down the goblin hill and open the two chests in the throne room to receive a {item:Steel Shield} and a {item:Silver Amulet}.
Steal the greedy goblins' small treasure.
Sewer in the southwest corner of Edron castle
If nobody has been through the cave for a while, you may have up to 10 {creature:Goblin|Goblins} waiting for you at once.
From the **Edron** depot, go down the sewer in the **southwest** corner of the castle.
There is only one path: follow the cave until you come out in a grassy area.
Going down at the goblin hill
Head **southwest** until you find the goblin hill and go down the hole.
Get ready to face up to 10 {creature:Goblin|Goblins} at once.
Follow this path **northwest** and go down the hole.
Follow the path to the hole in the **northeast** corner and go down.
Path to the northeast corner hole
Here there are more goblins and 2 {creature:Wasp|Wasps}.
The reward is in two chests in the throne room, to the **north**. Open both.
Throne room with the two chests

Go back the same way: return to the holes you went down and use the {item:Rope} on each one to climb up, until you come out at the goblin hill ({coord:33107,31848,7}). Then head **northeast** to the grassy area ({coord:33129,31811,7}) and retrace the cave to the **Edron** castle sewer ({coord:33165,31828,7}).
